name: RTI-126
summary: RTI-126 (RTI-4229-126 or (–)-2β-(1,2,4-oxadiazol-5-methyl)-3β-phenyltropane) is a phenyltropane derivative which acts as a potent monoamine reuptake inhibitor and stimulant drug, and has been sold as a designer drug. It is around 5 times more potent than cocaine at inhibiting monoamine reuptake in vitro, but is relatively unselective.

pharmacology.text: RTI-126 (RTI-4229-126 or (–)-2β-(1,2,4-oxadiazol-5-methyl)-3β-phenyltropane) is a phenyltropane derivative which acts as a potent monoamine reuptake inhibitor and stimulant drug, and has been sold as a designer drug. It is around 5 times more potent than cocaine at inhibiting monoamine reuptake in vitro, but is relatively unselective.

uses.text: RTI-126 (RTI-4229-126 or (–)-2β-(1,2,4-oxadiazol-5-methyl)-3β-phenyltropane) is a phenyltropane derivative which acts as a potent monoamine reuptake inhibitor and stimulant drug, and has been sold as a designer drug. RTI-126 has been sold as a designer drug, and was scheduled in New Zealand as a temporary class drug on 27 December 2012.

summaryZh: RTI-126是一種有機化合物，化學式C17H21N3O，化學名：-2β-(1,2,4-噁二唑-5-甲基)-3β-苯基莨菪烷（英語：-2β--3β-phenyltropane），開發代號：RTI-4229-126，可作為多巴胺再攝取抑制劑以及狡詐家藥物。
summaryZhHans: RTI-126是一种有机化合物，化学式C17H21N3O，化学名：-2β-(1,2,4-𫫇二唑-5-甲基)-3β-苯基莨菪烷（英语：-2β--3β-phenyltropane），开发代号：RTI-4229-126，可作为多巴胺再摄取抑制剂以及狡诈家药物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Stimulants of this kind can cause a racing heart, high blood pressure, anxiety, sleeplessness, overheating and paranoia, and repeated use can lead to compulsive redosing and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類興奮劑可能引起心跳過快、高血壓、焦慮、失眠、體溫過高和偏執，反覆使用可能導致強迫性追加和依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类兴奋剂可能引起心跳过快、高血压、焦虑、失眠、体温过高和偏执，反复使用可能导致强迫性追加和依赖。

fact.en: In RTI-126 the ester group of cocaine is replaced by an oxadiazole ring, a small ring containing nitrogen and oxygen that enzymes cannot cut.
fact.zh: 在 RTI-126 中，古柯鹼的酯基被換成惡二唑環，這是一個含氮和氧的小環，酵素無法將它切斷。
fact.zhHans: 在 RTI-126 中，古柯碱的酯基被换成恶二唑环，这是一个含氮和氧的小环，酵素无法将它切断。
